name: Red Team Operations Playbook
selection_reason: Operaciones ofensivas completas: desde recon hasta exfiltración, con C2 y persistencia.
template: Red Team Ops: Recon → Initial Access → C2 Setup → Lateral Movement → Privilege Escalation → Persistence → Collection → Exfiltration → Reporting.

name: Purple Team Engagement Model
selection_reason: Colaboración ofensiva-defensiva para mejorar postura de seguridad.
template: Purple Team: Plan attack scenarios → Execute → Observe defense → Tune detection → Repeat → Measure improvement.

name: Atomic Red Team Tests
selection_reason: Tests atómicos individuales para validar controles de seguridad específicos.
template: Ejecutar tests atómicos por tactic: Initial Access → Execution → Persistence → Privilege Escalation → Defense Evasion → Credential Access → Discovery → Lateral Movement.

name: Cobalt Strike Attack Scenarios
selection_reason: Escenarios de ataque usando Cobalt Strike para simulation avanzada.
template: CS Scenarios: Phishing → Beacon → Execute → lateral move → PSExec/WMI → Domain dominance → Data exfil.

name: Detection Engineering Playbook
selection_reason: Ingeniería de detecciones: crear, testear y mejorar alertas de seguridad.
template: Detection Eng: Map TTPs → Write detection rules → Test with atomic red team → Tune false positives → Deploy → Monitor → Iterate.

name: Breach and Attack Simulation (BAS)
selection_reason: Simulación continua de brechas para validar defensas.
template: BAS: Select attack scenarios → Execute automatically → Measure detection rate → Identify gaps → Remediate → Re-test.

name: Supply Chain Attack Simulation
selection_reason: Simular ataques a cadena de suministro: dependencias maliciosas, CI/CD compromise.
template: Supply Chain Sim: Inject malicious dependency → Compromise CI/CD → Tamper build artifacts → Test detection → Assess impact.

name: Insider Threat Simulation
selection_reason: Simular amenazas internas: abuso de privilegios, data exfil, sabotage.
template: Insider Sim: Assume compromised credentials → Access sensitive data → Attempt exfil → Test DLP → Test UEBA → Assess response.

name: Cloud Red Team Playbook
selection_reason: Operaciones ofensivas en entornos cloud: AWS, Azure, GCP.
template: Cloud Red Team: Enumerate cloud assets → Test IAM → Escalate privileges → Access storage → Pivot to on-prem → Exfiltrate → Clean up.

name: Adversary Emulation Playbook
selection_reason: Emular grupos APT específicos usando su TTPs documentados.
template: Adversary Emulation: Select APT group → Map their TTPs to ATT&CK → Emulate each technique → Test detection → Measure coverage.

name: Assume Breach Methodology
selection_reason: Asumir que la brecha ya ocurrió y testear capacidades de detección y respuesta.
template: Assume Breach: Inject indicators → Test SIEM alerts → Measure MTTD → Test IR playbook → Measure MTTR → Identify gaps.
